item.title: Perisher 2026
item.description: Around a week in Jindabyne… …managing four days skiing at Perisher, since one day was rained off and the weekend was deemed likely to be too busy (with limited snow cover reducing the extent of the ski field).

item.title: Tasmania 13 - 19 April 2026
item.description: Tasmania for a week of… …rest, golf, driving, walking, eating and drinking. Cover image: Autumn colours in the Japanese garden at the Tasmanian Royal Botanical Garden. Holiday week meant no weights, but lots of stretching (to counter the effects of sitting around on sofas, beds and in cars).
